Offers | Junior Coder/Tester

Junior Coder/Tester

Qurios Oy Helsinki, Uusimaa, Finland Hybrid Internship
Open application

About the Role

Greetings Hivers!

We are an edu tech startup developing a digital tool to support teachers.

We are looking for an internship candidate who can handle mainly html and Javascript, has an eye for retro visuals and bonus points if likes to sort out some math in the backend. (we have a beautiful excel sheet with cute probabilities waiting for you]

The candidate would support our product developer in coding and testing our google extension version of the tool.

With the possibility of staying with us later when we start testing and selling the product in the classrooms.

Good English is a must, every other language is a bonus.

Cheers!

Apply via Email

Please attach your CV and in the email, dont forget to tell us about yourself and your passions. We are looking for team chemistry.
